name: wondercart
description: Wondercart e-commerce — Angular client + Express API, deployed together on Vercel

scripts.build: cd client && npm install && npm run build

comments.dependencies: These mirror server/package.json. Vercel installs only this root package.json when bundling the /api serverless function, so the API's runtime dependencies have to be declared here too. Keep the two lists in sync when you add a server dependency.
